verdict.rationale: Mintlify's first-party docs describe generating interactive API documentation from OpenAPI specs with automatic endpoint pages and request builders, under a dedicated /api-playground docs section. The API reference use-case page calls the docs "interactive for developers" and mentions an API playground, and the pricing page lists "API playground" as a platform feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation that readers send live requests to real endpoints (auth/credential handling, response display), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground.
